name: Murmuration
description: Starlings over an evening sky, each a small dark chevron turned by a swirling field, crowding large and close where the flock is thick and dwindling to specks at its edge.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @rn(-50, 50, 1.3); --k: @rn(-0.3, 1.6, 1.2); --s: $(max(0.22, min(1.2, k))); -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a)); transform: rotate($deg(a)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -4%; top: 4%; width: 78%; height: 44%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--bird); clip-path: @var(--bird); -webkit-transform: scale($(s)); transform: scale($(s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 34%; top: 52%; width: 68%; height: 40%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--bird); clip-path: @var(--bird); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(-14deg, 14deg)) scale($(s)); transform: rotate(@r(-14deg, 14deg)) scale($(s)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
